| description = Always followed by his polar bear companion, [[Iceberg]]. After spawning he immediately sprints south at jboots speed across the mountains. Beware if you're using Wolf Form to traverse the zone, he will attack you.

If killed first, [[Iceberg]] will almost immediately despawn.

Trivia: Tundra Jack is inspired by Yukon Cornelius from the Rankin and Bass 1964 stop motion animated television special Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer. Besides the name similarity they are both prospectors on a frigid tundra and make reference to silver and gold.
